text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Uhhh... Where am I? Why am I here?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Is anyone here? Big Brother...<n>Anyone?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Is anyone here? Big Sister... Anyone?
I've found you, Sable Assassin.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Gyah! Wh-who are you?!

text_block_list.name: Vampire
text_block_list.text:
Mwahaha, I have come to visit you. I<n>am the King of
Darkness—a vampire.

text_block_list.name: Vampire
text_block_list.text:
Now, come with me. I shall make a<n>feast of your
blood!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...And then I woke up.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower seems low on energy<n>during training. I
ask her about it and<n>she tells me about a nightmare
she<n>had.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry. I know how important<n>getting enough
sleep is!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: This is all my fault!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I'm the one who recommended that<n>vampire book...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not your fault, Rob Roy! I was<n>the one who
asked... I was just a bit<n>curious with Halloween
coming up...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It was scary, but a dream is just a<n>dream. All you
have to do is wake<n>up... I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Still, sleep deprivation won't do any<n>good for her
training. We can't let this<n>continue...
choice_data_list: Should we get you a protective charm?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Still, sleep deprivation won't do any<n>good for her
training. We can't let this<n>continue...
choice_data_list: Should we get you a protective charm?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A protective charm?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower looks confused, so I<n>show her a pair
of replacement cleats<n>I brought with me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Is there something special about<n>those cleats?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I see! They say cleats can function as<n>a protective
talisman!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I've read that the fairies who bring<n>nightmares hate
iron... We should<n>hang those up in our dorm room
immediately!
choice_data_list: Do you need more? I can get them if you do.
Do you need more? I can get them if you do.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: More?! Where would we even put<n>them?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'll help as well. Should we<n>hang one at the
entrance to the dorm<n>too?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
In that vein, I've heard that sage can<n>also prevent
bad dreams. Do you<n>want to go pick some with
me?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy... Big Brother...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy... Big Sister...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. As long as I have you<n>two, I'm sure
everything will work<n>out!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower's smile has returned.<n>The next
morning, she announces<n>that she slept well.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that no matter how powerful<n>they might be,
a vampire is probably<n>no match for an Umamusume
who<n>trains hard.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: R-really? If you say so, I guess it<n>must be true...
choice_data_list: All right. I'll play the vampire, then.
All right. I'll play the vampire, then.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: R-really? If you say so, I guess it<n>must be true...
choice_data_list: All right. I'll play the vampire, then.
All right. I'll play the vampire, then.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eeeek!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower dashes away in the blink<n>of an eye.
She may be screaming, but<n>I can't help but notice
how strong her<n>start is!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Just like that, Rice! If you can picture<n>this while
you're dreaming, I'm sure<n>that nightmare won't
bother you any<n>longer!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Really? Okay, I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: And so, our vampire eradication<n>training continues...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Great work! How are you feeling,<n>Rice?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... I don't think I'm asscared anymore!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah... but I've realized something.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If the vampire is actually someone<n>like you, I don't
want to defeat it... I'd<n>rather be friends.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If the vampire is actually someone<n>like you, I don't
want to defeat it... I'd<n>rather be friends.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So... ummm... the next time they<n>shows up in my
dream, I'll do my<n>best to befriend them!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower is too kind for her own<n>good.
